name: Auto Rate
description: Analyses your whole level and adds themed decoration: glow edges, crowns, hazard glow, city skyline, background shapes, color and pulse triggers.

quality.name: Quality
quality.description: Fast = light, Ultra = dense decoration (more objects, takes longer).

bg-mode.name: Background
bg-mode.description: Off = leave the level's background alone. Colors = set background/ground colors. Full = colors + a few shapes in empty areas.

crown.name: Crown spikes
crown.description: Add decorative spikes on top of platforms (non-solid, behind the player).

pulses.name: Pulse effects
pulses.description: Add pulse triggers along the level.

replace-previous.name: Replace previous run
replace-previous.description: Delete the decoration from an earlier Auto Rate run before adding the new one.

y-offset.name: Y offset
y-offset.description: Shift everything Auto Rate adds up (+) or down (-), in units. 30 = one block.

analysis-time.name: Analysis time (seconds)
analysis-time.description: How long the analysis runs before the decoration is placed. 0 = instant.
